Logic: If two dice have the same face value in the given image then their clockwise or anticlockwise wise number are known as opposite numbers in dice.

In the first dice and second dice. The letter 'P' is common.

The left letters will be opposite each other writing them clockwise starting from P.

Here, we can see that the letter opposite to M is Q.
